title: Reschedule request — compliance items & exec travel conflict
text:
Reschedule request — compliance items & exec travel conflict

["From: Bethany Wu <bethany@novamed.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro/demo for NovaMed — proposed dates

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the intro — we reviewed Redwood's brief and would like to schedule the exec demo you mentioned. Leadership is available the week of Nov 8–12; earliest preference is Nov 10 in the afternoon PT. A couple of notes from procurement/security:

- Our vendor intake portal still shows the questionnaire as incomplete; legal needs the signed NDA before exec-level access.
- We may need SSO metadata and a copy of your SOC 2 scope for the pre-demo checklist.

If you can provision access for a technical lead earlier (so our engineers can validate integration points), that would help move things forward while procurement works through the form.

Thanks,
Bethany
Bethany Wu
Director, Strategic Sourcing | NovaMed Health

Attachments: none
", "From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: Bethany Wu <bethany@novamed.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro/demo for NovaMed — proposed dates

Hi Bethany — great to hear you're ready to move to an exec walkthrough. Quick notes so we can avoid last-minute pauses: 

- We saw the vendor portal flag — I'll attach a short pre-demo checklist and a screenshot of the minimum inputs procurement asks for. If your legal team can return the NDA, we can open the exec slot.
- If Nov 10 is still preferred, Karthik can do a technical pre-brief with your engineering leads earlier that day (30–45m) so the exec time is focused on business outcomes.

Proposed next steps:
1) Procurement signs/scans NDA (we can accept DocuSign).
2) NovaMed finishes vendor questionnaire fields in the portal (I included the specific fields in the checklist).
3) Karthik runs a 30m technical sync on Nov 10 at 11:00 AM PT — if that works for your team, we hold the 2:00 PM PT exec slot tentatively.

Evelyn, can you confirm support coverage if the exec needs an expanded Q&A on deployment modes?

Best,
Olga Petrov
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: pre-demo-checklist.pdf; vendor-portal-screenshot.png
", "From: Bethany Wu <bethany@novamed.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: NovaMed Procurement <procurement@novamed.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 07:48:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro/demo for NovaMed — proposed dates

On Tue, Nov 3, 2026 at 11:03 AM Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Hi Bethany — great to hear you're ready to move to an exec walkthrough. Quick notes so we can avoid last-minute pauses: 
> 
> - We saw the vendor portal flag — I'll attach a short pre-demo checklist and a screenshot of the minimum inputs procurement asks for. If your legal team can return the NDA, we can open the exec slot.

Thanks, Olga — appreciate the checklist. Two updates from our side: 

1) Procurement confirmed the questionnaire still has a couple of missing fields (SSO metadata + data retention row). They won't clear the exec-level demo until those are submitted.
2) Our VP of Product and one exec were scheduled to be in Europe the week of Nov 8–12 for an acquisition diligence trip; Nov 10 is no longer possible for the exec cohort.

Given both items, can we do one of the following: 
- Option A: Move the exec demo to the week of Dec 6 (gives procurement time to finish the portal and execs to be back), or
- Option B: Run a focused technical deep-dive next week for engineering stakeholders (no execs) to keep momentum and unblock integration questions.

If you can run the technical session, please include an agenda and any pre-read. Procurement included expected evidence items in their portal notes — happy to share if that helps.

Regards,
Bethany

Attachments: none
", "From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: Bethany Wu <bethany@novamed.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro/demo for NovaMed — proposed dates

Thanks for the clarity, Bethany. Totally understood on both counts — thanks for flagging procurement's specific fields and the exec travel. Quick plan to keep the deal moving without waiting for the exec window: 

- We'll schedule the technical deep-dive (Option B) for next week. Proposed slot: Nov 9, 10:30 AM PT — 45 minutes. Karthik will cover integration patterns, SSO/IdP examples, and our inference deployment options (hosted, dedicated, private).
- I'll send a short pre-read and the checklist (attached) to procurement to make it as easy as possible to mark the portal fields complete. If procurement can return the NDA via DocuSign within 5 business days, we can target the exec demo the week of Dec 6 as you suggested.
- If NovaMed wants, we can provide a minimal-access link for a sandbox environment for engineering to test with (requires signed MSA addendum; we can scope that to a limited dataset).

Agenda for Nov 9 technical deep-dive (45m):
- 5m: Intros & goals
- 15m: Architecture + integration requirements (Karthik)
- 15m: Deployment options & latency/cost tradeoffs (Evelyn)
- 5m: Q&A & next steps

Please confirm the Nov 9 slot or propose two alternatives. I'll also drop procurement a note with the pre-demo checklist and the exact SSO fields we need.

Best,
Olga

> --
> Olga Petrov
> Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
> Attachments: pre-demo-checklist.pdf; vendor-portal-screenshot.png
"]
